notes.title: GGnZ Release is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We at Evil Bunneh are very happy and excited to announce that Girls, Guns and Zombies is now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/d5ebc3209ea2839b851418d0dfdfafa4970f165e.png[/img]

[b]Take advantage of 15% Off release discount![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580480/Girls_Guns_and_Zombies

Join us in a thrilling, action packed zombie shooter and share your experiences with us, the developers. We are eager to hear your feedback and your ideas of new features and how we can improve the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38376873/9bb32087b449a20a6e1bf27d90a95360dd8f1c7e.png[/img]

Girls Guns & Zombies is exactly that, girls with guns shooting zombies. While, having some poolside fun in between. Scavenge the ruined city overrun by the undead, collect resources and throw a party for the girls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38376873/c38fbe2ef158bc36882c478b8aad4532c8f37bdb.png[/img]

Features:

• Beautiful, stylized characters
• A city to explore
• Thrilling action gameplay
• Post-apocalyptic setting
• Pool party with girls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/bd409bb228b8ab76bc8e6f9fff181dfb3b658ced.png[/img]

Thank you!
